description.value: The Boat Shed Ambleside is a casual, seasonal waterfront restaurant sitting directly on Ambleside Beach in West Vancouver, offering both indoor dining and outdoor patio seating with sweeping ocean and mountain views. Part of the Boat Shed Hospitality Group's three-location portfolio, it serves fish and chips, pizza, coffee, and ice cream through both a dine-in room and a dedicated take-out window. Its location at the west end of the North Shore seawall makes it a natural stopping point for cyclists on the Ambleside waterfront route.
